titulo.en: Three past tenses in a story

intro.en: Use context to notice completed events, background and experiences connected to the present.

texto.en: The **indefinido** commonly moves a finished story forward: **Llegué a las ocho**. The **imperfecto** describes a background, habit or ongoing situation: **Llovía**. The **perfecto** often presents an experience or period connected to the present: **Esta semana he leído dos libros**. This last choice varies across Spanish-speaking regions; some speakers use the simple past in contexts where others use the perfect. The examples here use a common Spain-oriented contrast, not a rule for every region.

titulo.en: A visit to the old school

frases.es: Esta semana he vuelto a mi antiguo colegio por primera vez en muchos años.
frases.en: This week I have returned to my old school for the first time in many years.

frases.es: Cuando era pequeño, iba allí andando con mi hermana porque vivíamos cerca.
frases.en: When I was little, I used to walk there with my sister because we lived nearby.

frases.es: Ayer llegué temprano y esperé en la puerta. Llovía, pero el conserje me reconoció.
frases.en: Yesterday I arrived early and waited at the door. It was raining, but the caretaker recognised me.

frases.es: De repente, salió mi antigua profesora. Hablamos un rato y recordamos el último curso.
frases.en: Suddenly, my former teacher came out. We talked for a while and remembered the final school year.

frases.es: En el patio seguían los mismos árboles, pero ya eran mucho más altos que en mi último curso.
frases.en: The same trees were still in the playground, but they were much taller than in my final school year.

frases.es: Al despedirnos, mi profesora me dijo que varios antiguos alumnos querían organizar una reunión para el verano.
frases.en: As we said goodbye, my teacher told me that several former students wanted to organise a reunion for the summer.

frases.es: Desde entonces he pensado mucho en aquella época.
frases.en: Since then I have thought a lot about that time.

titulo.en: What does each tense do here?

nota.en: The perfect and simple past can be distributed differently across regions.
